notes: Works outside the UK: choose your Country and Time zone (in the setup wizard’s Your family step, and Configurator → Advanced → Locations & home). They set the time zone for everything, public holidays for your country, map searches, °F and mph in the USA (km/h outside the UK and USA), and the cash-in currency
Bins: outside the UK, bin days are set up by hand (or from a council calendar link) – finding them from your council is UK-only
Trains and Bus stop are labelled “UK”; outside the UK the wizard skips their keys and hides those widgets
